006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * Provides a convenient way to raise a
015 * {@link TypeMetapathException#INVALID_TYPE_ERROR}.
016 */
017public class InvalidTypeMetapathException
018    extends TypeMetapathException {
019
020  /**
021   * the serial version UID.
022   */
023  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
024
025  /**
026   * The item associated with this invalid type error, or {@code null} if no
027   * specific item was provided.
028   */
029  @Nullable
030  private final IItem item;
031
032  /**
033   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item} and {@code cause},
034   * using a default message.
035   *
036   * @param item
037   *          the item related to the invalid type error
038   * @param cause
039   *          the original exception cause
040   */
041  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
042      @NonNull IItem item,
043      @NonNull Throwable cause) {
044    super(
045        INVALID_TYPE_ERROR,
046        String.format("Invalid data type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()),
047        cause);
048    this.item = item;
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item} and no cause, using
053   * a default message.
054   *
055   * @param item
056   *          the item related to the invalid type error
057   */
058  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
059      @NonNull IItem item) {
060    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, String.format("Invalid data type '%s'", item.getClass().getName()));
061    this.item = item;
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item}, {@code message},
066   * and {@code cause}.
067   *
068   * @param item
069   *          the item related to the invalid type error
070   * @param message
071   *          the exception message
072   * @param cause
073   *          the original exception cause
074   */
075  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
076      @Nullable IItem item,
077      @Nullable String message,
078      @NonNull Throwable cause) {
079    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, message, cause);
080    this.item = item;
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code item}, {@code message},
085   * and no cause.
086   *
087   * @param item
088   *          the item related to the invalid type error
089   * @param message
090   *          the exception message
091   */
092  public InvalidTypeMetapathException(
093      @Nullable IItem item,
094      @Nullable String message) {
095    super(INVALID_TYPE_ERROR, message);
096    this.item = item;
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Get the associated item, if provided for the exception.
101   *
102   * @return the item or {@code null} if not item was provided
103   */
104  @Nullable
105  public IItem getItem() {
106    return item;
107  }
108}
